change_applications_status_valid.name: change_applications_status_valid
change_applications_status_valid.value: ("change_applications"."status" = 'pending' AND "change_applications"."applied_at" IS NULL) OR ("change_applications"."status" = 'applied' AND "change_applications"."applied_at" IS NOT NULL)

development_repository_preparation_valid.name: development_repository_preparation_valid
development_repository_preparation_valid.value: ("development_repositories"."prepared" IS NULL AND "development_repositories"."prepared_at" IS NULL) OR ("development_repositories"."prepared" IS NOT NULL AND "development_repositories"."prepared_at" IS NOT NULL)

development_rounds_preparation_valid.name: development_rounds_preparation_valid
development_rounds_preparation_valid.value: ("development_rounds"."input" IS NULL AND "development_rounds"."prepared_at" IS NULL) OR ("development_rounds"."input" IS NOT NULL AND "development_rounds"."prepared_at" IS NOT NULL)

development_rounds_capture_valid.name: development_rounds_capture_valid
development_rounds_capture_valid.value: ("development_rounds"."candidate" IS NULL AND "development_rounds"."captured_at" IS NULL) OR ("development_rounds"."input" IS NOT NULL AND "development_rounds"."candidate" IS NOT NULL AND "development_rounds"."captured_at" IS NOT NULL)

development_rounds_verification_intent_v.name: development_rounds_verification_intent_valid
development_rounds_verification_intent_v.value: "development_rounds"."verification_intent" IS NULL OR "development_rounds"."candidate" IS NOT NULL

development_rounds_verification_input_va.name: development_rounds_verification_input_valid
development_rounds_verification_input_va.value: ("development_rounds"."verification_input" IS NULL AND "development_rounds"."verification_prepared_at" IS NULL) OR ("development_rounds"."verification_intent" IS NOT NULL AND "development_rounds"."verification_input" IS NOT NULL AND "development_rounds"."verification_prepared_at" IS NOT NULL)

development_rounds_verification_result_v.name: development_rounds_verification_result_valid
development_rounds_verification_result_v.value: ("development_rounds"."verification_result" IS NULL AND "development_rounds"."verified_at" IS NULL) OR ("development_rounds"."verification_input" IS NOT NULL AND "development_rounds"."verification_result" IS NOT NULL AND "development_rounds"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

development_rounds_review_valid.name: development_rounds_review_valid
development_rounds_review_valid.value: ("development_rounds"."review" IS NULL AND "development_rounds"."reviewed_at" IS NULL) OR ("development_rounds"."verification_result" IS NOT NULL AND "development_rounds"."review" IS NOT NULL AND "development_rounds"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

repository_creations_identity_valid.name: repository_creations_identity_valid
repository_creations_identity_valid.value: ("repository_creations"."status" IN ('created', 'linked') AND "repository_creations"."repository_id" IS NOT NULL AND "repository_creations"."repository_id" > 0 AND "repository_creations"."full_name" IS NOT NULL) OR ("repository_creations"."status" NOT IN ('created', 'linked') AND "repository_creations"."repository_id" IS NULL AND "repository_creations"."full_name" IS NULL)

repository_creations_link_valid.name: repository_creations_link_valid
repository_creations_link_valid.value: ("repository_creations"."status" = 'linked' AND "repository_creations"."import_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("repository_creations"."status" != 'linked' AND "repository_creations"."import_id" IS NULL)

service_observation_result_valid.name: service_observation_result_valid
service_observation_result_valid.value: ("service_observations"."success" = 1 AND "service_observations"."snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND json_valid("service_observations"."snapshot") AND "service_observations"."error_code" IS NULL) OR ("service_observations"."success" = 0 AND "service_observations"."snapshot" IS NULL AND "service_observations"."error_code" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_goal_binding_valid.name: tasks_goal_binding_valid
tasks_goal_binding_valid.value: ("tasks"."goal_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."goal_version" IS NULL AND "tasks"."kind" = 'work') OR ("tasks"."goal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."goal_version" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."goal_version" > 0)
